QuestInfo.name: [Dragon Boat Festival] Making Tasty Zongzi
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra is making the traditional treat Zongzi for people all over Maple World. Go meet Cassandra and ask how you can help.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra is making Zongzi again to share with friends in Maple World. Help Cassandra by gathering ingredients for #b#t2022786##k. \nThere's a rumor that you can get the ingredients from monsters...
QuestInfo.2: You helped Cassandra gather ingredients for #b#t2022786##k and received #b#t2022786##k x1. You can eat it yourself or share with friends.

0.0: Hi, #b#h0##k. It's tradition to make Zongzi each year during the Dragon Boat Festival. Maple Administrator came to me a few days ago and asked me to make Zongzi for the travelers of Maple World. But I can't make all that Zongzi on my own no matter how skilled I am. Can you help me?

yes.0: Alright! Let's begin. We can make Zongzi if you gather the necessary materials. First...let's make #b#t2022787##k. We're going to need #b#t4032950# x15#k and #b#t4032951# x15#k. Since all the monsters drop Zongzi materials during the Dragon Boat Festival, you'll get them easily. I'll be waiting here, so come back as soon as you can!

no.0: Everyone else would jump at the chance to help, but you don't want to? How unfortunate.

1.0: Wow! You're back sooner than I expected! Good job. You got all the materials I asked for, right?

yes.0: Ta-da! I made #b#t2022787##k with the materials you gathered. Here, this is for you. Please keep helping me. There are so many more Zongzi to be made!
